def clean_tokens(series):
    # Unify casing to lowercase to merge variant spellings and improve lookup coverage
    s = series.astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    s = s.str.replace(r"\s*([,.!?;:\(\)\[\]])\s*", r"\1", regex=True)
    s = s.str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True)
    return s

def build_freq_map(series_b, series_a):
    cnts = {}
    for b, a in zip(series_b, series_a):
        b_key = str(b)
        a_key = str(a)
        cnts[b_key] = cnts.get(b_key, {})
        cnts[b_key][a_key] = cnts[b_key].get(a_key, 0) + 1

    mapping = {}
    for b_key, fm in cnts.items():
        max_freq = max(fm.values())
        candidates = [x for x, c in fm.items() if c == max_freq]
        mapping[b_key] = min(candidates, key=lambda x: (len(x), x))
    return mapping

def ru_num2words(n):
    n = abs(n)
    if n == 0: return "ноль"
    if n < 10: return ONES[n]
    if n < 20: return TEENS[n - 10]
    if n < 100: return TENS[n // 10] + (" " + ONES[n % 10] if n % 10 else "")
    if n < 1000: return HUNS[n // 100] + (" " + ru_num2words(n % 100) if n % 100 else "")
    q, r = divmod(n, 1000)

def apply_structured_fallback(predictions, originals):
    updated = predictions.copy()
    oov_mask = predictions == originals
    oov_indices = oov_mask[oov_mask].index
    if len(oov_indices) == 0: return updated
    tok_series = originals[oov_indices]
    
    mask_trans = tok_series.str.contains(r"_trans\b$", regex=True)
    if mask_trans.any():
        updated.iloc[mask_trans[mask_trans].index] = tok_series[mask_trans].str.replace(r"_trans\b$", "", regex=True)
        
    mask_dec = tok_series.str.match(r"^\d+\.\d+$")
    if mask_dec.any():
        fixed = tok_series[mask_dec].apply(lambda x: f"{x.split('.')[0]} точка {x.split('.')[1]}")
        updated.iloc[mask_dec[mask_dec].index] = fixed
        
    mask_pct = tok_series.str.match(r"^\d+%\s*$")
    if mask_pct.any():
        base = tok_series[mask_pct].str.extract(r"^(\d+)%")[0]
        updated.iloc[mask_pct[mask_pct].index] = base.apply(lambda x: f"{x} процент")
        
    mask_frac = tok_series.str.match(r"^\d+/\d+$")
    if mask_frac.any():
        fixed = tok_series[mask_frac].apply(lambda x: f"{x.split('/')[0]} чисел {x.split('/')[1]}")
        updated.iloc[mask_frac[mask_frac].index] = fixed
        
    updated.iloc[oov_indices] = updated.iloc[oov_indices].str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True)
    return updated

def enhanced_numeric_fallback(series_in, series_orig):
    updated = series_in.copy()
    oov_mask = updated == series_orig
    oov_vals = series_orig[oov_mask]
    for idx in oov_mask[oov_mask].index:
        tok = str(oov_vals.loc[idx]).strip()
        neg = ""
        if tok.startswith("-"):
            neg = "минус "
            tok = tok[1:]
            
        digits = re.sub(r"[^0-9]", "", tok)
        if digits.isdigit():
            updated.loc[idx] = neg + ru_num2words(int(digits))
        elif digits and len(digits) <= 8:
            base_pred = tok
            if "," in tok: base_pred = base_pred.replace(",", " ")
            if "." in tok: base_pred = re.sub(r"\.", " точка ", base_pred)
            base_pred = re.sub(r"\d+", lambda m: ru_num2words(int(m.group())), base_pred)
            base_pred = re.sub(r"minus\s+", "минус ", base_pred, flags=re.I)
            updated.loc[idx] = neg + base_pred.strip()
    return updated
